hero.title: Savor Fresh Flavors: Highland Nectar, Bengaluru's Gardenia Culinary Gem.
hero.subtitle: Nestled within ITC Gardenia, discover a vibrant menu crafted from the freshest ingredients, inspired by global tastes and local charm.

about.title: The Highland Nectar Experience
about.paragraph1: At Highland Nectar, we believe dining is an art, a journey for the senses. Located in the luxurious ITC Gardenia, Bengaluru, our restaurant offers an exquisite culinary escape where every dish is a celebration of fresh, high-quality produce and masterful preparation.
about.paragraph2: Our philosophy centers on bringing you a harmonious blend of international culinary excellence with a distinctive local touch. From vibrant appetizers to decadent desserts, immerse yourself in an atmosphere of refined elegance and unparalleled taste, making every visit a memorable occasion.
